design_reference: docs/design/09-feedback.md (non-blocking notification stack); corner-anchored snackbar/toast anatomy
note: Pins the project-authored Material composition of the native notification overlay shell -- the surface the rewrite ledger tracks as native:notification-overlay-window (WIN-SHL-003). The overlay is NOT stock LibreOffice chrome: it is an InterimItemWindow child of the owning work-area frame (never a FloatingWindow, which would auto-dismiss on focus loss, and never an OS top-level) that anchors bottom-right with Material insets and hosts the Material notification stack .ui. Three halves are pinned: (a) the host vehicle and its bottom-right anchoring entry point in NotificationOverlayWindow.{hxx,cxx}; (b) the Material anchoring preference defaults (420 width, 16/16 insets) in include/sfx2/notificationcenter.hxx that the anchoring call consumes; (c) the controller wiring in NotificationStackController.cxx that loads sfx/ui/notificationstack.ui, welds the stack widgets, lets Tab escape back to the document, and calls RepositionBottomRight with those preferences. governed_surfaces enumerates the rewrite-ledger rows whose Material rendering rides this channel; the ledger's composition cross-reference names this contract back. Source evidence only: runtime_verified is false -- no native build, overlay pixels, or runtime capture are claimed.

governed_surfaces.note: The overlay shell itself: host vehicle, bottom-right anchoring and the stack .ui it hosts. The Material card anatomy inside it is credited separately by the sfx2/uiconfig/ui/notificationcard.ui ledger row and is NOT re-counted here.

header_markers: void RepositionBottomRight(sal_Int32 nHInset, sal_Int32 nVInset, sal_Int32 nDesiredWidth);
host.absent_note: The overlay must stay a frame-child InterimItemWindow. A FloatingWindow/WorkWindow base would auto-dismiss on focus loss or become an OS top-level, both of which break the non-blocking corner-anchored contract; this guard fails closed if either is reintroduced.

fields.name: Width
fields.role: overlay width budget clamped to the parent client area

fields.name: MaxVisible
fields.role: visible-card budget before the overflow affordance

controller.focus_escape_note: The stack lets Tab escape back to the document so an informational notification never traps focus while typing.

stack_ui.note: Non-dialog GtkBox top level so the Windows dialog-notification contract does not count it as a modal. Material 9px stack rhythm on both the outer box and the card box; every welded id must exist in the .ui or the controller weld fails at runtime.

ledger.note: Each governed surface must exist in the rewrite ledger with the declared family. When a governed row is credited rewritten-material its rewrite_evidence.anatomy_markers.contract_marker must be this contract's `contract` value, which is what the ledger's own composition cross-reference validator re-checks.
